text:
Maya: quick flag — while updating the quickstart for SDK v8 I noticed the TypeScript snippet uses the old `RedwoodClient` ctor signature. migration guide still shows the v7 usage.
Owen: which file?
Maya: docs/quickstart/hello-js.md and docs/migrations/sdk7-to-8.md. the TS code should use `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` not the older `new RedwoodClient(...)`.
Priya: thanks. that mismatch will confuse newcomers. also found a broken link in the migration guide pointing to a removed repo path. link-bot, can you list all links in that doc?
link-bot: Found 1 dead link in docs/migrations/sdk7-to-8.md -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/old-repo/examples/hello.
Owen: plan: 1) update TS and JS snippets in quickstart to SDK v8 shape 2) update migration guide wording + fix link 3) add a tiny example in examples/hello/v8 showing auth and first deploy 4) add docs-ci smoke that lints snippets for the new ctor pattern.
Maya: I'll open a PR that changes snippets, swaps the link, and adds examples/hello/v8/README.md with a short run-through.
Priya: can you also include a one-line note under "What changed" in the migration guide about env var name standardization (REDWOOD_API_KEY)? we still get questions about token names.
Maya: yep. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/720 — includes snippet updates, fixed link, example folder, and a snippet-lint step in docs-ci.
Owen: i skimmed the PR — small nit: prefer `Redwood` exported from `@redwoodai/sdk` in examples to match the package docs. also add a tiny unit test that greps for `new Redwood(` across docs to ensure CI fails if old ctor remains.
Maya: added the grep-based check and adjusted imports. pushed an additional commit.
link-bot: re-checking links in branch: no dead links found.
deploy-bot: docs build started for PR 720 (job: docs-ci)
deploy-bot: docs build succeeded for PR 720 (job: docs-ci, duration: 2m 9s). snippet-lint passed.
Priya: LGTM, merging. i'll note this in the next release notes under "Onboarding & quickstart".
Maya: thanks everyone — filing a follow-up issue to scan other migration guides for old ctor names and to add a short test to the docs linter.
Owen: thanks @Maya, this should make the SDK upgrade path smoother for new users. closing thread.
